bundle.shortDescription: Read, annotate, and convert PDFs in a focused desktop workspace.
bundle.longDescription: PDFreader is an offline-first Windows desktop workspace for reading multiple PDFs side by side, annotating them, keeping linked notes, and exporting annotated copies, Word documents, Markdown, text, and page images.
